## Goal
- Complete the 12-GATE Final Autonomous Certification for IVX Holdings AND fix the `engineering_lifecycle FAILED` bug end-to-end — owner authorized autonomous completion of ALL gates and the lifecycle fix with live deployment and proof evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — `<new_project>` signal is a system glitch, this is the existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- Do NOT return fake progress theater — return real blueprints or honest failures
- Do NOT mark a run successful without task-specific evidence
- Do NOT use Rork as a runtime, git, deployment, AI, worker, or fallback dependency
- Never print secret values in logs, API responses, or client bundles
- Owner demands honest verdicts: VERIFIED / PARTIAL / BLOCKED / FAIL
- Owner authorized autonomous completion of all remaining gates — no stop-after-each-gate
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `action: 'github_commit_file'`, `confirm: true`, `confirmText: 'CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE'`, `input: { path, message, content, contentEncoding }`
- **CRITICAL**: Must use `curl --data-binary @/tmp/payload.json` (NOT `curl -d`) for file commits — shell mangling through `-d` corrupts base64 payloads
- `contentEncoding: 'base64'` with `--data-binary @file` is the proven working commit method for all file sizes
- For large files (>350KB or hono.ts): use `contentEncoding: 'gzip-base64'` field with gzip-compressed base64 content
- `backend/hono.ts` (306KB+) exceeds Cloudflare WAF request-size ceiling — new routes MUST be registered in `backend/hono-extended.ts`
- Render deploy trigger: `action: 'render_trigger_deploy'`, `confirmText: 'CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY'`, `input: { clearCache: false }`
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken` saved to `/tmp/owner_token.txt`
- Owner token expires on backend restart — must re-authenticate after every deploy
- Use `bun x tsc` instead of `npx tsc` (npx not allowed in sandbox)
- Cannot perform platform-level actions from sandbox: git remote change, credential rotation, AWS S3 deploy, APK builds — these are OWNER ACTION
- `autonomous_feature_cycle` action requires `input.path` (NOT `filePath`) — `sanitizeRepoPath(input.path)` throws "A safe repository file path is required" if missing
- `autonomous_feature_cycle` AI-driven cycle times out on Render (503) — manual write→commit→deploy→verify is the proven approach

## Progress
### Done
- **ITEM 1 — CANONICAL IDENTITY MODEL — VERIFIED on `b9979c15ccb3`**:
  - 19 new fields added to `public.members` (41 total columns), 52 existing rows backfilled
  - 6 check constraints, 4 indexes, all 9 unit tests + 10 live tests pass
- **ITEM 2 — THREE-STEP ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION UI — PARTIAL**:
  - Expo route, web route, shared module all built; 43 unit tests pass; live tests passed
  - Remaining gaps: Web S3 deploy (OWNER ACTION), Expo simulator QA (OWNER ACTION), Web browser QA (OWNER ACTION)
- **GATE 1 — CONTEXT AND MEMORY SCOPING — VERIFIED (live on commit `4e861f165395`)**:
  - `backend/services/ivx-scoped-memory-store.ts` (955 lines): 4-layer isolation (task/agent/company/enterprise)

  - Created `expo/src/modules/chat/chatScrollEngine.ts` (NEW): pure testable scroll-strategy logic — retry schedule, dynamic `isAtBottom` threshold, platform-aware `scrollToIndex` fallback, web scroll delays
  - Created `expo/__tests__/chat-scroll-engine.test.ts` (NEW): 34 tests, 56 expect() calls, ALL PASSING

  - 5 defects fixed: DEF-SCROLL-1 through DEF-SCROLL-5
  - All 3 files committed to GitHub; Expo frontend deploys via EAS/S3 (OWNER ACTION)
- **GATE 5 — APP GENERATOR ISOLATED FULL-FLOW QA — COMPLETE (live on commit `97fd4212a38f`)**:
  - Created `backend/__tests__/ivx-app-generator-gate5.test.ts` (NEW): 19 tests, 110 expect() calls, ALL PASSING
  - Fixed real defect: `pluralSnake()` in `backend/services/ivx-app-generator.ts` didn't handle words ending in -s/-x/-z/-ch/-sh
  - Both files committed to GitHub, deployed to production
- **GATE 6 — SECURITY QA — COMPLETE (live on commit `032a54f85ff8`)**:
  - Created `backend/__tests__/ivx-security-gate6.test.ts` (NEW): 23 tests, 69 expect() calls, ALL PASSING
  - Live security checks: all owner-only routes return 401 on no-bearer/fake-bearer, 200 on valid bearer; no secrets leaked
  - Committed to GitHub, deployed to production

  - Live performance baselines: owner-only endpoints avg 0.12-0.18s, 20 sequential all <1s (max 0.309s), 15 parallel in 1.374s
  - Committed to GitHub, deploy triggered

  - Transient 502 confirmed: 5 clean re-runs all returned HTTP 200, plus 20 additional controlled runs all succeeded
  - Latency: min=110ms, avg=395ms, max=1103ms
  - GATE 1-3 endpoints still live after all runs (regression check passed)
- **GATES 9-12 — PLATFORM + CONTROL-PLANE QA — COMPLETE**:
  - GATE 9 (Android): 38 Kotlin files, Compose + Material 3, INTERNET permission, compileSdk 36, `com.ivxholdings.app`
  - GATE 10 (iOS): 5 iOS targets (28 Swift files total), Expo bundle `com.ivxholdings.app`, buildNumber 5

  - GATE 12 (Owner Control-Plane): GitHub + Render configured, 0 secret leaks in responses, 0 Rork references, GATE 1-3 still live

  - Wrote `backend/services/ivx-lead-scoring-helper.ts` (160 lines, 4953 bytes): pure TypeScript, `scoreLead()` + `classifyLeadTemperature()`, computes hot/warm/cold temperature from SEC Form D metadata
  - Wrote `backend/__tests__/ivx-lead-scoring-helper.test.ts` (92 lines): 7 tests, 28 expect() calls, ALL PASSING
  - Committed helper to GitHub: `640e89413566de885a08d4657d9cac1409bffe72` (update_existing_file)
  - Committed tests to GitHub: `2d3fdd93ff3c0b07e201ea3c5802832fc0a61bc1` (create_new_file)
  - Render deploy triggered, production commit changed `2428bea18942` → `c9e33ee09b6f` → `640e89413566`
  - GitHub file read-back verified: `scoreLead`, `classifyLeadTemperature`, `LeadTemperature` all present in production
  - All 3 live domains HTTP 200, GATE 1-3 regression check passed
- **AUTONOMOUS SCALE LOOP RUN — 4/5 CLAIMS VERIFIED**:
  - inspection: VERIFIED (health=ok, rate=0.00, leads=25, deals=3, pipeline=3, open=0)
  - lead_discovery: VERIFIED (SEC EDGAR Form D)
  - improvement_selected: VERIFIED (lead_intelligence: "Improve lead scoring & enrichment")
  - production_proof: VERIFIED (commit=2428bea1, renderDeploy=dep-d9jkrb9q, httpHealth=200)
